proof_body:
by
  intro g U n hn hU hs hg h0
  obtain ⟨f, h1, h2⟩ := Complex.exists_continuousOn_eqOn_exp_comp hs hU hg.continuousOn (by
    rintro ⟨z, hz, hz0⟩
    exact h0 z hz hz0)
  have hfd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U := by
    intro z hz
    have hzn := hU.mem_nhds hz
    have hfc : ContinuousAt f z := h1.continuousAt hzn
    have hgz := hg.differentiableAt hzn
    have hq : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w => Complex.log (g w / g z)) z := by
      apply DifferentiableAt.clog (hgz.div_const _)
      simp [div_self (h0 z hz)]
    have hev : f =ᶠ[nhds z] fun w => f z + Complex.log (g w / g z) := by
      have hsmall : ∀ᶠ w in nhds z, ‖f w - f z‖ < Real.pi := by
        have : Filter.Tendsto (fun w => ‖f w - f z‖) (nhds z) (nhds ‖f z - f z‖) := (hfc.sub continuousAt_const).norm
        simp only [sub_self, norm_zero] at this
        exact this.eventually (gt_mem_nhds Real.pi_pos)
      filter_upwards [hsmall, hzn] with w hw hwU
      have e : g w / g z = Complex.exp (f w - f z) := by
        rw [Complex.exp_sub]
        have a1 : Complex.exp (f w) = g w := h2 hwU
        have a2 : Complex.exp (f z) = g z := h2 hz
        rw [a1, a2]
      have him : |(f w - f z).im| < Real.pi := lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) hw
      rw [e, Complex.log_exp (by linarith [(abs_lt.mp him).1]) (by linarith [(abs_lt.mp him).2])]
      ring
    exact ((differentiableAt_const _).add hq).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev |>.differentiableWithinAt
  have hn' : (n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn
  refine ⟨fun z => Complex.exp (f z / n), (hfd.div_const _).cexp, fun z hz => ?_⟩
  simp only
  rw [← Complex.exp_nat_mul, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hn']
  exact h2 hz
target_source: ∀ (g : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ) (n : ℕ), n ≠ 0 → IsOpen U → IsSimplyConnected U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U → (∀ z ∈ U, g z ≠ 0) → ∃ f : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U ∧ ∀ z ∈ U, f z ^ n = g z
